svg.title: Level 3 faceplate P-101A and two-stage command barrier
svg.desc: Equipment faceplate built from horizontal Moving Analog Indicators (speed, discharge pressure, VFD output), a 10-minute micro-trend, start permissives and a command area; right side shows the select, arm, confirm, dispatch and readback sequence.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Level 3 Faceplate — Built from MAIs, Guarded by Arm-and-Execute
